confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for July 2026 from general knowledge. No live listings or booking pages were checked, and no web sources were used for prices. Remembered prices were brought forward to 2026 with allowance for post-2022 price growth. Meal, coffee and dorm anchors are moderately certain. Beer is the least certain restaurant anchor and is bounded to typical licensed-venue pricing. Cocktail and wine were derived from beer at about 2.3x and 2.7x because direct knowledge of local bar prices is weak. The 3-star hotel has the widest range given July peak-season demand. USD anchors assume roughly 16,000 to 17,000 rupiah per US dollar. The FX observation comes from an RBA search-result summary dated 2026-10-15; the RBA page itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: No live comparables were pulled. The basis is general knowledge of mid-sized Indonesian tourist-city price levels, loosely benchmarked against budget-to-mid Southeast Asian backpacker cities such as Chiang Mai. Bali's resort premium is excluded.
